title: 2016 Kaohsiung earthquake
summary: A magnitude 6.4 earthquake struck southern Taiwan early on 6 February 2016, at the start of the Lunar New Year holiday. It toppled a 17-story apartment building in Tainan, killing at least five people and trapping about 35. It also cut power to 168,000 households and damaged some chip wafers.

reviewer_note: Sources give only an early death toll (at least five) and no final figure. ISC origin time is UTC on 5 February, while local time was 6 February. The Reuters magnitude of 6.4 matches ISC Mw, though other papers cite ML 6.6, and the sources do not mention the name Kaohsiung explicitly.
